name: Essensinformationssystem (EIS 2.0)
author: Hardy Zindler

sections.description:
This plugin gives you the ability to quickly and easily integrate the standard software EIS 2.0 for the automation of meal ordering into your website and significantly reduce the administrative effort involved in organizing orders.

Since EIS is a cloud solution hosted by us, please also review our privacy policy for the app.

You can find it at the following link:

https://softwareschmiede-kiel.de/datenschutz-app

To create a free account, please use the link in step 1 on the plugin’s settings page or the following link:

https://softwareschmiede-kiel.de/register-form/

After registration, the online portal itself will be available at the following URL:

https://eis-online-portal.com/
sections.faq:
Wozu dient das Plugin?

Das Pligin ermöglicht eine unkomplizierte Einbindung der Speisepläne und der Bestellansicht des EIS 2.0 in WordPress!

short_description: EIS 2.0 is an online ordering system developed for the digitalization of school catering.
